evidence_support: OPTIMIZE_PROCESS(Fe, full) feasible with lowest observed cost USD/t: 15.2917 at T=425°C, P=180 bar, Tsep=30°C, bed=17.06 m3 (<90 m3).
OPTIMIZE_PROCESS for Cu, Co, Mo, W, Re returned infeasible due to bed-volume exceeding limit (no feasible states within admissible domain under vessel/bed correlation).

COMPUTE_ACTIVITY shows Co has highest intrinsic activity among evaluated set vs Fe and others (log10_TOF reference: Co -9.827 > Fe -5.31? actually higher means greater TOF; among evaluated: best is Co with largest log10_TOF).
TEST_REACHABILITY for Co shows maximum intrinsic activity multiplier along frozen scaling manifold can reach 2.59e6; classified reachable.
